Definition: Jochanan, the name of nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Johanan is named 22 times in the Bible, and the passages here are 2 Kings 25:23; 1 Chronicles 3:15; Ezra 8:12. In 2 Kings 25:23 we read, "And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and Ezra 8:12 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Johanan teaches me that faithfulness does not need fame to be recorded. The Bible does not waste names, and neither does God.
RelatedPeople: Johanan, Son of Careah; Johanan, Son of Josiah; Johanan, Son of Hakkatan
